name: Yuzu Chaya
description: A quiet, editorial theme for small Japanese tea and wagashi shops that sell loose-leaf sencha, hojicha and matcha, teaware and seasonal sweets online: washi paper and kinari surfaces, sumi ink, sencha green and roasted hojicha brown with a single dot of yuzu, large still-life photography, Shippori Mincho titles over Hanken Grotesk text, hairline rules and a deliberate twelve-column grid with generous whitespace that folds to one calm column on a phone, plus a brewing guide with temperatures and times, a monthly tea box subscription with plans and a signup form, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
